_how_to_use: Each case is a chat turn and the facts its context must contain. A case passes when every string in 'must_contain' appears in the context build_rag_context() returns (whitespace collapsed, so a re-chunk that moves line breaks still matches). Write facts as text from the source document, never from an answer. 'product' is the product picked in chat. 'control' cases pass today: they guard retrieval changes against regressions.
